Create a business partner

Make a supplier you can buy from, or a customer you can sell to.

Status

Module
Common, Procurement, Sales

Start

Summary

TaskWhat you doResultSteps
1Enter the business partnerThe partner is saved with its address and its ordering roles10

Before you start

  • You need a training company you're allowed to add business partners to.

Procedure

1Enter the business partner

Result
The partner is saved with its address and its ordering roles.
Session
Master Data➔Business Partners➔Easy Entry Business Partner (tccom4201m000)

Why LN works this way. A business partner is anyone you buy from or sell to. Its roles say which: a supplier buys from you through a buy-from role and ships from a ship-from role, and a customer through sold-to and ship-to. Easy Entry makes the partner, its first address and those two roles in one go, from a defaults template.

StepActionYou should see
1.1Open the lookup on Business Partner Defaults and choose 200 Suppliers for a supplier, or 100 Customer for a customer
1.2Set Business Partner Role to Supplier or CustomerUnder Create Roles, Buy-from and Ship-from are ticked for a supplier, or Sold-to and Ship-to for a customer
1.3Set CountryExampleCountry USA
1.4Leave Business Partner as LN fills it inLN numbers the partner when it's made
1.5Enter the partner's Name
1.6Under Address, check the NameIt's the partner's name
1.7Enter the ZIP Code/Postal Code and press TabState/Province and City fill in
1.8Check the City
1.9Enter the Street
1.10Click CREATEThe status bar says the partner is created, with its numberWrite downbusiness partner
Enter the business partner: if something goes wrong
SymptomWhat to do
The roles under Create Roles don't match the templateChange Business Partner Role. The template only takes effect then. See step 1.2

2Add the invoice and payment roles

Result
The partner has all four roles a supplier or a customer needs.
Session
Master Data➔Business Partners➔Business Partners (tccom4500m000)

Why LN works this way. Invoices use a third role, invoice-from for a supplier or invoice-to for a customer, and payments a fourth, pay-to or pay-by. Those belong to a financial company. If you work in a company that does only logistics, LN won't make them there, so you change to the financial company first and back afterwards.

StepActionYou should see
2.1Open Options➔Change CompanyChange Company opens, with your company in Selected Company
2.2Enter your financial company in Selected Company and press TabIts name appears beside it
2.3Click OK
2.4Open Master Data➔Business Partners➔Business PartnersThe status bar shows the financial company
2.5Filter the list on the partner from step 1.10Its row
2.6Open its rowBusiness Partner opens. Under Roles, two have a green tick
2.7Click Invoice-from for a supplier, or Invoice-to for a customerThe role opens, with the partner's address filled in
2.8On the Invoicing tab, choose the financial group from the lookup on Financial Supplier Group, or Financial Customer Group for a customer
2.9For a customer, choose Invoicing Method from its lookup
2.10For a customer, on the Credit Control tab, choose a Credit Rating whose action is Never Hold (Credit)
2.11On the Paying tab, choose Payment Terms from its lookup
2.12Click SaveThe status bar says Modify
2.13Close the role
2.14Click Pay-to for a supplier, or Pay-by for a customerThe role opens, with the address filled in
2.15Click SaveThe status bar says Modify
2.16Close the role and click RefreshFour roles have a green tick
2.17Do steps 2.1 to 2.3 again with your own company
Add the invoice and payment roles: if something goes wrong
SymptomWhat to do
LN says the role can't be made in a logistic only companyYou're still in the logistic company. Change company, then open the list again. See steps 2.1 to 2.4
LN says Payment Terms is neededSee step 2.11
LN says Credit Rating is neededSee step 2.10
A role won't open or saveYour user may not be allowed to make roles. Ask whoever manages LN users
